summary: Hopp is a remote pair programming application designed for collaborative coding sessions. It provides ultra-low-latency 4K screen sharing alongside shared drawing tools and remote control functionality. Operating under the AGPL-3.0 licence, it serves as an open-source alternative to proprietary collaboration tools.
goodFor: Development teams who want to host their own remote collaboration infrastructure or require high-definition screen sharing for pair programming.
watchOut: Low-latency 4K streaming demands significant network bandwidth and server resources, and the platform competes in a space with established commercial alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised application distributed via Docker, it typically requires persistent storage for configuration data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination properly.
